title: Elodie and the Witness
author: Ivo Vane
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
